title: Almost complete graphs determined by Laplacian hook immanantal polynomials
summary: Let \(\mathscr{G}_n\) be the family of simple graphs obtained from \(K_n\) by deleting at most five edges. For a fixed integer \(1\leq k\leq n\), let \(Φ_k(L(G),x)\) denote the immanantal polynomial of the Laplacian matrix associated with the hook partition \((k,1^{n-k})\). We prove that, for \(n>7\) and \(n\neq 2k-1\), every graph in \(\mathscr{G}_n\) is determined by \(Φ_k(L(G),x)\) among all simple graphs.
